source.title: DEV SIZINTI - ABLA HERKESİ PATLATTI
source.note: Turkish live stream that walks through Casino Secrets records of Turkish-facing betting brands. Summaries below paraphrase what the video says; they are claims by the video, not findings of this project. The video is not available from Türkiye. Names follow the video; where the register spells them differently the register spelling is added (see each mention's note).

mentions.claim: Artemisbet is shown as a brand of SXM Management; the related entity is Demet Şahin, whom the video describes as the wife of Veysel Şahin.
Other domains listed under SXM Management include Betper, Masbahis, Perabet and Truvabet.
A register document names Demet Şahin as UBO and Mustafa Yılmaz as former UBO, and records her as an Albanian national.
Financial statements filed for SXM Management show total assets of about EUR 60 million (2022), EUR 69 million (2023) and EUR 84 million (2024).
SXM Management's business plan lists Venusbet, Truvabet and Betper among its sites.
Searching Perabet, Mr. Bahis, Imajbet, Safirbet, Savoybet and Alexabet leads to Demet Şahin; Savoybet sits under Longterm Interactive.
A document is approved by Salih Gökhan, described as an accountant/auditor based in Cyprus; the video calls him a key person for following the money.
Casibom is shown under Seguri N.V., with Şerif Elmas as the related person.
Milanobet is shown under Codex B.V., with Ali Faki as owner/manager and 80+ domains.
Kralbet is shown under Feel So Good B.V. with Veysel Demir; the video calls him a key name that appears across many sites.
Betturkey also leads to Veysel Demir.
Istanbulbahis is shown under Maltech Technology N.V., with İrfan Sabahattin Şakir as the related person.
mentions.note: Register spelling: Irfan Sebahatin Shakir (Maltech Technology N.V.).

mentions.claim: Mavibet is shown under Coinbar N.V. with Uğur Mercan, Mehmet Gördağ and Şevket Ayaksız; the company lists 33 sites including Zirvebet, Jojobet and Lunabet.
Tipobet is shown under Grace Bay B.V., again with Veysel Demir.
Mersobahis is shown under Joker Marketing B.V. with Zurab Kadir.
Meritpremium is shown under Redline B.V.; the video then lists Şeref Yazıcı's sites and describes him as Veysel Şahin's right hand whose crypto assets were seized in Türkiye.
mentions.note: The automatic captions say "Redline"; the register company is Red Lane B.V.

mentions.claim: Redline B.V. (domains such as Primebahis, B1bahis, Turbobahis) is shown with Kadir Uğur as owner and manager; Demir Karakuş is named as another key person. The video claims these are front names for Erkan Başer.
mentions.note: Captions say "Redline" and "Kadir Uğur"; the register shows Red Lane B.V. with Kartal Ugur.
